description: Change the start time, stop time and/or run days of one existing program in a Jandy AquaLink RS panel’s schedule (iAqua systems), through WebTouch. Identify the program exactly as iaqualink_list_schedules listed it (page, row, circuit, start, stop, days) — if the panel no longer shows that, nothing is pressed. The circuit itself cannot be changed (delete and add instead). The preview shows the list before and after; the result re-reads it. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

days.description: Its current run days, as listed

page.description: The page the schedule was listed on (from iaqualink_list_schedules)

start.description: Its current start time, HH:MM as listed

stop.description: Its current stop time, HH:MM as listed

name: iaqualink_edit_schedule
